skipReasons.controlledServiceFailure: Public Vercel Lab has no test-only failure hook. Aborting production POSTs would couple the contract to today's Next.js server-action transport rather than an observable product seam.
skipReasons.controlledWordlistFailure: Public Vercel Lab has no test-only failure hook, and the client word-list URL is a hashed framework chunk rather than a stable resource the contract can fail.
skipReasons.practiceSession: Practice is disabled in production Lab, so a complete session cannot run against this target.
